method: Read-only live OpenBMC MTD test through deployed-source validation, preview adapter, lazy directory scanner and real CLI background-operation polling. Unoptimized test binary; no cache eviction or cold-cache claim. Terminal redraw time excluded.

native_laptop.ui_method: 200x60 private-session PTY attached to the existing native daemon; select exact MTD artifact and press 3. Includes terminal redraw; graphics probing disabled. No cache eviction.

boundary: Uses the exact image's retained build-generated IMAGE_ROOTFS; does not mount, decode or certify flash-image contents. No image build or daemon restart.
reproduce: Set YOCTUI_ROOTFS_BENCH_BUILD, MACHINE, IMAGE, ARTIFACT (.mtd), MANIFEST; cargo test --locked -p yoctui --bin yoctui rootfs_live_mtd_files_loading_benchmark -- --ignored --nocapture
